Potential_Failure_Mode: Speaker negative lead shorts to chassis ground
Potential_Failure_Effects: BTL H-bridge lower MOSFET overcurrent, catastrophic TPA3116 die destruction
Potential_Causes: Metal-to-chassis contact through conducting rear plate or loose terminal washers
Current_Design_Controls_Prevention: Isolate binding posts from aluminum frame
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Bench DMM continuity check before power
Recommended_Action: Mount all 12 binding posts into 4mm non-conductive Polycarbonate rear panel; eliminate all conductive chassis path

Potential_Failure_Mode: TPA3116 die temperature exceeds 150°C junction limit
Potential_Failure_Effects: Amplifier thermal shutdown, audio dropout, long-term silicon aging
Potential_Causes: XH-M562 uses Top-Pad (DAD) TPA3116D2 IC; internal pipes alone have limited surface area (~174 cm2)
Current_Design_Controls_Prevention: Stock glued mini-heatsink on chip top
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Thermal probe on Left Finned Wall during max load test
Recommended_Action: Connect TOP of all 3x horizontal TPA3116D2 chips via 3x Aluminum/Copper L-Angle Bridges directly to Left External Finned AL6061 Wall (150x87x25mm, 480 cm2 exposed to room fan/AC cooling = 30W+ capacity) + 1x Central Ø35mm Sealed Copper Chimney for residual internal heat
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Max cooling headroom via External Left Finned Wall + Central Copper Chimney

Potential_Failure_Mode: Voltage drop/sag (> 3.5V) during high-transient bass hits
Potential_Failure_Effects: Audible clipping, distortion, low-frequency rail pumping, brownout
Potential_Causes: High internal resistance on long umbilical or inadequate reservoir capacitance
Current_Design_Controls_Prevention: Standard Mean Well SMPS internal output caps
Recommended_Action: Bridge 4700uF 50V Low-ESR bulk electrolytic reservoir capacitor directly across WAGO 221-415 bus bars
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: 4700uF cap buffers transient current surges

Potential_Failure_Mode: Digital full-scale (0 dBFS) clipping into DAC inputs
Potential_Failure_Effects: Audible harmonic distortion (> 10% THD), harsh treble clipping
Potential_Causes: Overdriven software gain scaling or volume multiplier mismatch in firmware
Recommended_Action: Firmware hard limit set at 83.6% voltage amplitude ceiling (70% power ceiling = 210W peak unclipped)
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Permanent firmware limiter keeps TPA3116 in <0.05% THD window

Potential_Failure_Mode: Bit Clock (BCK) or Word Select (LRCK) skew and jitter
Potential_Failure_Effects: Channel phase misalignment, digital clicks, DAC decoding failure
Potential_Causes: Long daisy-chained clock traces with excessive parasitic capacitance (> 50pF)
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Logic analyzer multi-channel clock timing verification
Recommended_Action: Star clock distribution bus with trace runs < 60mm; stack DACs directly behind ESP32 front panel
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Short parallel clock lines, jitter < 50ps

Potential_Failure_Mode: Buck output drifts above 5.5V logic absolute maximum
Potential_Failure_Effects: Permanent overvoltage burnout of ESP32-S3, DACs, and ADC
Potential_Causes: Potentiometer wiper vibration drift or failure under heat
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Bench multimeter verification before logic plug-in
Recommended_Action: Pre-calibrate buck trimmer with thread-locking compound; add zener clamp overvoltage crowbar on 5V logic bus
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Multi-turn cermet trimmer glued at 5.00V DC

Potential_Failure_Mode: Ground loop 50Hz/100Hz mains hum induced into analog signal
Potential_Failure_Effects: Audible hum through all 6 speakers, degraded SNR (< 75 dB)
Potential_Causes: Multiple ground return paths between input jack, DAC ground, and power ground
Recommended_Action: Isolated audio ground path; shielded 2-core cable grounded strictly at DAC AGND end only
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Single-point star audio grounding; SNR > 102 dB

Potential_Failure_Mode: Internal SMPS fan switches ON during quiet listening sessions
Potential_Failure_Effects: Acoustic background fan noise (38 dBA) destroys listening ambiance
Potential_Causes: Thermal load on internal SMPS heatsink exceeds 50°C fan threshold
Recommended_Action: External wall mounting of SMPS outside cube + ESP32 70% power ceiling keeps PSU load <= 60% (fan remains off)
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: SMPS permanently silent during home theater playback

Potential_Failure_Mode: Faraday cage attenuation drops RF signal (> 25 dB loss)
Potential_Failure_Effects: Bluetooth audio dropouts, loss of web dashboard connectivity, erratic playback
Potential_Causes: All-metal aluminum chassis enclosure completely shielding internal antenna
Recommended_Action: Adopt 4-Face Polycarbonate enclosure (Front, Back, Top, Bottom) with dielectric constant er ≈ 2.9 (RF transparent)

Potential_Failure_Mode: Thermal softening or optical haze on top plate around copper pipe
Potential_Failure_Effects: Top panel distortion, loosened chimney seal, aesthetic degradation
Potential_Causes: Continuous conductive heat transfer from central copper pipe (> 65°C) to plastic
Current_Design_Controls_Prevention: Direct contact between copper pipe and laser cutout
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Thermal chamber stress testing at 60°C ambient
Recommended_Action: Insert high-temperature silicone rubber isolation grommet between copper chimney and polycarbonate top plate
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Silicone thermal barrier isolates copper tube from plastic

Potential_Failure_Mode: Mains Live conductor loose wire touches external chassis
Potential_Failure_Effects: Electric shock hazard, user injury, ground fault trip
Potential_Causes: Vibration loosening screw terminal or insulation abrasion on sharp metal edge
Recommended_Action: 3A fused IEC socket with heat-shrink insulated boot + M4 star-washer chassis ground bonding (< 0.1 ohm)
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Full double insulation on AC side and certified PE bond

Potential_Failure_Mode: DAC powers up before external system clock stabilizes
Potential_Failure_Effects: Pop noise on power-on, soft-mute stuck in muted state
Potential_Causes: Asynchronous power-up between XL4015 buck and ESP32 I2S clock generator
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Oscilloscope timing trace on VCC vs BCK rise time
Recommended_Action: Hardwire PCM5102A SCK pin directly to GND to enable internal PLL; ESP32 initializes audio bus before unmuting
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Automatic PLL generation and zero pop noise on boot

Item_Function: RGB LCD DMA & GPIO Pin Contention on Model 28141
Potential_Failure_Mode: 16-bit RGB LCD consumes I2S GPIOs and PSRAM DMA bandwidth; or wireless HMI battery depletes
Potential_Failure_Effects: Inability to wire 3x I2S DACs directly to Model 28141, audio buffer underrun crackling during touch gestures, or loss of control if remote sleeps
Potential_Causes: Single-chip sharing of 800x480 60fps RGB DMA with 6-channel I2S + biquad DSP
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Schematic pinout audit & DMA stress test
Recommended_Action: Split architecture: Add dedicated Waveshare ESP32-S3 Dev Board with Pre-Soldered Headers (SKU: 1552780) inside amp for 6-Ch I2S DSP + store active volume/EQ in NVS so amp plays uninterrupted if wireless 4.3B Touch Remote sleeps
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Ordered SKU 1552780; 100% isolated Audio DSP & Wireless/I2C HMI

Item_Function: XH-M562 Soldered Header Pin Clearance & Chip-Top Coupling
Potential_Failure_Mode: 2.5mm soldered header pins on bottom of XH-M562 short against metal or block 10-pin plug
Potential_Failure_Effects: Dead short on +24V/BTL outputs if back of PCB touches metal; or blocked 10-pin connector if chip faces wall
Potential_Causes: Soldering 10-pin male headers creates 2.5mm bottom pin tips while long pins + IC thermal pad are on top face
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Visual & multimeter continuity inspection before power-up
Recommended_Action: Mount all 3x XH-M562 boards HORIZONTALLY on M3x8mm brass standoffs (Pins 1-3 audio plug on top, Pins 4-9 18AWG soldered below, Pin 10 CS open); 3x L-Angle Bridges reach from Left External Finned Wall onto center TPA3116D2 chip tops, opposite the inner header edge
Action_Taken_Status: Implemented: Horizontal floor mounting + Left Finned Wall L-Bridges + zero pin interference

Item_Function: Bluetooth Classic A2DP Audio Reception on ESP32-S3
Potential_Failure_Mode: ESP32-S3 (SKU 1552780 & Model 28141) supports BLE 5.0 only (no BR/EDR Classic A2DP)
Potential_Failure_Effects: Inability to stream phone/TV Bluetooth music directly to ESP32-S3; ground-loop hum or double-conversion loss if analog BT chained carelessly into PCM1808
Potential_Causes: Espressif omitted Bluetooth Classic BR/EDR radio from ESP32-S3 silicon
Recommended_Action: Add dedicated Bluetooth Classic A2DP audio receiver: either I2S-output BT bridge (original ESP32-WROOM-32) into ESP32-S3 DIN (zero ADC loss), or XY-WRBT BT 5.0 module on clean isolated 5V feeding PCM1808 at <=80% level for active 6-ch crossovers
Action_Taken_Status: Documented in BT_RECEIVER_PCM1808.md; awaiting module selection

Item_Function: Slave ESP32-WROOM-32 (Surround) I2S slave on Pico clocks
Potential_Failure_Mode: Slave audio task late or Wi-Fi/ESP-NOW preemption causes I2S underrun; settings out of step between Pico and Slave
Potential_Failure_Effects: Audible click on surrounds; surround level jumps relative to mains on volume/mute change
Potential_Causes: I2S slave cannot pause the master clock; two MCUs each hold their own copy of volume/mute/EQ
Current_Design_Controls_Prevention: Dual-core 240 MHz Slave: audio task pinned to Core 1, ESP-NOW on Core 0
Current_Design_Controls_Detection: Listening test with continuous tone plus rapid volume changes
Recommended_Action: Large DMA buffers (e.g. 4 x 256 samples); light ESP-NOW handler; apply volume/mute at a timestamped sample boundary; fall back to wired UART from Pico if sync drifts
Action_Taken_Status: Planned: pin map in esp32.md section 3; to be verified at bring-up
